condoIntro.title: Comfortable Mexican-Style Living
condoIntro.description: Ideal for longer stays and remote work, Casa Jirafa offers more comfort and value than a typical small 1BR condo. Spread out and feel at home in walkable El Centro.

spacious.title: Spacious Layout
spacious.desc: 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths, full kitchen, in-unit laundry, and covered, free parking.

remote.title: Remote Work Ready
remote.desc: Fast 80/80 Mbps Wi-Fi with optional Ethernet. A/C in both bedrooms.

amenities.title: Resort Amenities
amenities.desc: Heated pool during winter months. Roku TVs in living room and master.

location.title: The Heart of El Centro
location.description: Casa Jirafa is located just a few blocks from the famous Puerto Vallarta Malecón. Step outside to find world-class dining, art galleries, and the vibrant local culture right at your doorstep.
location.mobilityDesc: The walk to the Malecón includes a steep stairway on the final stretch. While it provides our spectacular views, it is something to consider if mobility is a concern.

pricing.title: Nightly Rates
pricing.subtitle: Direct booking saves you up to 15% in platform fees.

merch.title: Take Casa Jirafa Home
merch.subtitle: Exclusive merchandise for our guests. Available for local pickup or worldwide shipping.
